scope: Read-only whole-script review and AST parsing only; no runner, Lean probe, exporter, comparator, kernel replay or production edit.
passed_static_checks: Every configured native owner has exactly its configured literal notation-clause count.
Actual frontend inventory requires private definitions with complete bodies and literal actual types ParserDescr/Macro/Unexpander, independently per physical owner on both sides.
Actual whole environment scan rejects further new-module frontend roots and other constant dependencies on the classified public roots in types and whole values.
Runner guards old/new physical source counts, new import closure, exact thirteen upstream-only names, source/native/control/public-artifact stability and shared-lock fair-reader execution.
Raw gzip and uncompressed hashes, row/byte/name/theorem counts, capture exit and transport status all remain checked.
Original Name remapping is used only to identify the already-renamed raw capture record; no Expr/Name/binder/number/proof normalization is introduced.
Every nonclassified actual root reaches the unchanged frozen comparator; raw differences must be confined to the exact typed frontend inventory.
Old three-parent classifier and frozen comparator actual file hashes remain unchanged.

finding.issue: The classifier validates witness content/counts but does not bind it to a successful runner exit/verification and current source/native/public-artifact/control fingerprints. It also does not verify the current exact thirteen upstream-only absence names. A stale witness from a same-count environment can therefore be combined with fresh raw captures.
finding.requested_fix: Bind the supplied witness to its successful sibling runner receipt and persisted input fingerprints (including controls), revalidate those before classification, and assert the actual absent-name list equals the current node-extract plan.
